newsitem.title: USA: World Bank to sharply boost agricultural lending.
newsitem.headline: World Bank to sharply boost agricultural lending.

text.p: The World Bank expects to significantly increase its lending to agricultural and rural projects, President James Wolfensohn said on Friday.
"You're going to see a significant increase in both agricultural and rural economic projects," he told a news conference. "There is a paradigm shift at the Bank."
While the Bank's history with rural loans has not been that good, that is where 70 percent of the poor live, he added.
